# Local Darwin storage dependency

Last Answer owns this narrow dependency patch under its root AGENTS.md.
Preserve upstream license/provenance and review the local diff before updating.
Never log credential bytes or run destructive fault controls on a live account.
Ordinary writes must preserve the prior item on replacement failure, and add only
when absence is definitive. Keep Secure Enclave multi-item guarantees separate.
Native gate: `bash tool/test_atomic_keychain.sh`; actual app compile/runtime is
additional evidence. Do not hand-edit CocoaPods or generated plugin registration.
